source_links.bts_master_coordinate: BTS TranStats Aviation Support Tables, Master Coordinate (https://www.transtats.bts.gov/)

units.clock_fields: Local HHMM at the origin (departure fields) or destination (arrival fields); 2400 is midnight ending the day

identifiers.flight_id: first 12 hex chars of flights.csv sha256, colon, 1-based data row number (header excluded)

timezone_assignment.zone_rules: IANA tz database via the pinned tzdata package
timezone_assignment.assignment: State default plus per-airport overrides in backend/data/timezones.py

layout_source.document: FAA Airport Diagram AL-375 (FAA), San Francisco Intl (SFO)
layout_source.magnetic_variation: 14 deg E (diagram annotation, January 2015, annual change 0.1 deg W)
layout_source.traffic_pairing_note: Layout effective 2026 paired with 2015 traffic. Differences between the 2015 and 2026 airfield are not modelled.

wake_category_rule.value: HEAVY if scheduled stage length >= 2000 statute miles else LARGE
wake_category_rule.basis: Proxy only. Aircraft type is not in the source and a tail number alone does not establish it.

taxi_in_min.basis: Unimpeded taxi-in used to estimate scheduled wheels-on from scheduled gate arrival

taxi_out_min.basis: Unimpeded taxi-out used to estimate scheduled wheels-off from scheduled gate departure

holding_fuel_available_min.basis: Uniform seeded draw per arrival: airborne holding available beyond the estimated scheduled landing before final reserve. Not a fuel load.

min_turnaround_min.basis: Minimum gate time from on-block to departure readiness

gate_dwell_cap_min.basis: Aircraft that arrived earlier than this before scenario start with no departure in the scenario are assumed towed off-gate

gate_headroom_factor.basis: Simulated gate count = ceil(peak scheduled gate demand x factor)

crew_duty_remaining_min.basis: Uniform seeded draw per aircraft rotation crew at scenario start

pushback_tug_use_min.basis: Tug occupied from scheduled off-block per departure

connections.basis: Passenger connections are not in the source. Same-airline arrival to departure pairs with a scheduled gap between 40 and 120 minutes are eligible; a seeded share is declared.

member1_rules.note: Separation, runway occupancy, intersection timing and objective weights are Member 1 simulation rules and are intentionally not set here.

rules_config.historical_cancellations: Included as scheduled demand; historical outcome kept under flight.historical

day_selection.rule: Most qualifying SFO rows on the local SFO day; ties by total movements, then earliest date

window_selection.rule: Whole-hour local start with the most qualifying SFO movements; ties by movements, then earliest

coverage_limits: BTS on-time data covers reporting carriers' scheduled domestic passenger legs only; international, cargo, general aviation and non-reporting regional traffic at SFO are absent.
Clock fields have one-minute resolution and no seconds.
No radar positions, runway, taxiway, gate or aircraft type are in the source rows.
October 2015 rows use numeric BTS airport IDs; without the BTS lookup they cannot be matched to SFO and October is excluded from day selection.
Time zone assignment per airport is curated and awaits review (see source_manifest.json).
Taxiway graph is a bounded abstraction of AL-375: main parallels A, B, C, L, the M apron connector and four runway crossings. Many real connectors and holding bays are omitted.
Gate identifiers and counts are simulated; AL-375 shows boarding areas, not gates.
Parallel runway spacing and all coordinates are schematic.
Layout effective 2026-10-29 is paired with 2015 traffic.
